verdict.rationale: Fireflies ships its own GraphQL API with static bearer-token API keys, so non-interactive scripts can submit work via the uploadAudio mutation and pull results via the transcript/transcripts queries. Completion webhooks and runnable code examples support event-driven automation without the UI, which covers the core of headless operation. However, nothing shows a CLI, a CI-specific workflow, or service-account style credentials, and the probe found no OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: official CLI or headless runner, CI/pipeline integration docs or examples, non-user service credentials, independent hands-on corroboration of automated use.
